A detention basin holds stormwater and releases it slowly so downstream channels do not flood, sized from the inflow hydrograph minus the allowed outflow. The sizer routes a design storm through trial basin volumes until the peak outflow meets the limit. Euler-integrates logistic growth dP/dt = r*P*(1-P/K) and prints the trajectory table with summary statistics.
